= Valkyria Chronicles III = 

 Senjō no Valkyria 3 : Unrecorded Chronicles ( Japanese : 戦場のヴァルキュリア3 , lit. Valkyria of the Battlefield 3 ) , commonly referred to as Valkyria Chronicles III outside Japan , is a tactical role @-@ playing video game developed by Sega and Media.Vision for the PlayStation Portable .

Released in January 2011 in Japan , it is the third game in the Valkyria series . The game was excluded from English release due to poor sales of Valkyria Chronicles II , though fan translations exist .

Employing the same fusion of tactical and real @-@ time gameplay as its predecessors , the story runs parallel to the first game and follows the " Nameless " , a penal military unit serving the nation of Gallia during the Second Europan War .
Players take control of Kurt Irving , commander of the Nameless , who wishes to redeem his squadmates ' honor while uncovering motivations behind the Gallian nobility .
Development began in 2010 after the release of Valkyria Chronicles II , carrying over all gameplay mechanics while introducing original characters and a darker tone .
Character designs were handled by Raita Honjou , who returned from the first game after sitting out the second installment .
The soundtrack was composed by Hitoshi Sakimoto , reprising his role from earlier entries in the franchise .
Critical reception in Japan was generally favorable , with praise for story depth and battle systems , though some reviewers noted repetitive mission structure .
Commercial performance was modest relative to handheld expectations , contributing to Sega 's later reluctance to localize sequels for Western markets .
Fan communities produced English patches to broaden access , citing narrative continuity with the original Valkyria Chronicles storyline .
Gameplay missions emphasize combined arms tactics , blending infantry movement with armor and support classes in grid @-@ based maps .
Post @-@ release downloadable content expanded side stories focusing on individual squad members and alternate scenarios .
